policy: Reviewed whole-film expanded or native tall presentations from 1.33:1 to 1.90:1. Unknown IMAX tags alone do not qualify. Release-labelled Open Matte discovery is a separate configurable tier; individual files are not verified.

movies.title: Avengers: Infinity War
movies.evidence: IMAX confirms whole-film expanded presentation; Disney confirms the IMAX Enhanced home edition.

movies.title: Avengers: Endgame
movies.evidence: The official IMAX comparison describes the entire film as expanded; Disney confirms the home edition.

movies.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
movies.evidence: The IMAX theater operator describes the entire IMAX presentation; Disney confirms the IMAX Enhanced home edition.

movies.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
movies.evidence: IMAX's press release explicitly confirms whole-film expanded aspect ratio; Disney lists the home edition.

movies.title: Blade Runner 2049
movies.evidence: Community restoration documentation identifies the full-frame Open Matte edition. Select an Open Matte file; the standard widescreen release does not qualify. This is community evidence rather than studio certification.

movies.title: Avatar
movies.evidence: Disc review confirms the expanded 1.78 home framing. Regular 2D Blu-ray/WEB files qualify; exclude cam, cropped and custom-frame releases.

movies.title: Avatar: The Way of Water
movies.evidence: Disc review confirms expanded 1.85 framing on Blu-ray and UHD. Regular 2D Blu-ray/WEB files qualify; exclude cam, cropped and custom-frame releases.

movies.title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
movies.evidence: Firsthand UHD review confirms the expanded 1.85 home transfer. Regular 2D Blu-ray/WEB files qualify; exclude cam, cropped and custom-frame releases.

movies.title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
movies.evidence: Firsthand UHD review identifies the full-frame 1.78 home presentation. Regular 2D Blu-ray/WEB files qualify; exclude cam, cropped and custom-frame releases.

movies.title: The Suicide Squad
movies.evidence: Firsthand UHD review explicitly confirms fixed 1.90 framing with no aspect-ratio shifts. Regular 2D Blu-ray/WEB files qualify; exclude cam, cropped and custom-frame releases.

movies.title: Zack Snyder's Justice League
movies.evidence: The cinematographer describes the full-frame 4:3 presentation, chosen to approximate IMAX proportions.

movies.title: The Avengers
movies.evidence: Firsthand UHD review confirms 1.85 on UHD and 1.78 on the prior Blu-ray; both qualify as tall native home framing.

movies.title: Pacific Rim
movies.evidence: Firsthand UHD review confirms the original 1.85 theatrical framing on the home transfer.

movies.evidence: Firsthand UHD review confirms the original 1.85 framing on the home transfer.

movies.title: Jurassic Park III
